amazon-linux-extras.notes: No equivalent in RHEL. Extras topics (e.g. nginx, redis, postgresql) map to individual RHEL AppStream module streams.

amazon-ssm-agent.notes: Available from the AWS RHEL repo. Install via: yum install -y https://s3.amazonaws.com/ec2-downloads-windows/SSMAgent/latest/linux_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.rpm

aws-cli.notes: RHEL does not ship aws-cli v1 by default. Install AWS CLI v2 from the AWS installer bundle.

ec2-utils.notes: Amazon-specific EC2 utilities. Use cloud-init and ec2-instance-connect on RHEL instead.

ec2-net-utils.notes: Amazon-specific network utilities for ENI management. RHEL uses NetworkManager natively.

amazon-linux-onprem.notes: Amazon Linux on-premises support package. Not applicable to RHEL.

kernel.notes: RHEL ships its own kernel. Version numbers differ (AL2 4.14/5.10 vs RHEL 8 4.18).

glibc.notes: RHEL 8 ships glibc 2.28. Check application compatibility if relying on specific glibc symbols.

openssl.notes: RHEL 8 ships OpenSSL 1.1.1. AL2 also ships 1.0.2 in some configurations.

openssl11.notes: AL2 compat package openssl11 maps to the default openssl in RHEL 8.

python2.notes: Available but deprecated in RHEL 8. Migrate to Python 3.

python3.notes: RHEL 8 default is Python 3.6. AppStream modules provide 3.8, 3.9, 3.11.

java-11-amazon-corretto.notes: Amazon Corretto is not packaged for RHEL. Use OpenJDK 11 or install Corretto from the AWS repo.

java-17-amazon-corretto.notes: Amazon Corretto 17 maps to OpenJDK 17 in RHEL 8 AppStream.

nodejs.notes: Available as AppStream module streams (10, 12, 14, 16, 18). Enable the matching stream.

nginx.notes: Available in RHEL 8 AppStream. Version may differ from AL2 extras.

docker.notes: RHEL 8 does not ship Docker. Use Podman (drop-in replacement) or install Docker CE from docker.com.

containerd.notes: RHEL 8 uses Podman/Buildah/Skopeo instead of Docker/containerd.

mariadb.notes: Available as AppStream module. Version may differ.

mysql.notes: MySQL 8.0 available as RHEL 8 AppStream module.

postgresql.notes: Multiple versions available as AppStream module streams (9.6, 10, 12, 13, 15).

redis.notes: Available as RHEL 8 AppStream module. May need to enable module stream.

php.notes: Available as AppStream module (7.2, 7.3, 7.4, 8.0). Enable matching stream.

ruby.notes: Available as AppStream module (2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 3.0, 3.1). Enable matching stream.

golang.notes: Go toolset available as AppStream module.

perl.notes: Perl 5.26 in RHEL 8. Additional modules as AppStream.

gcc.notes: Available in RHEL 8 AppStream. GCC 8 by default, newer via toolset.

iptables.notes: Available in RHEL 8 BaseOS. RHEL 8 prefers nftables as default firewall backend.

firewalld.notes: Available and enabled by default in RHEL 8.

ntp.notes: ntp/ntpd replaced by chrony in RHEL 8. Migrate NTP configuration.

cloud-init.notes: Available in RHEL 8 AppStream. AWS datasource supported.

ansible.notes: RHEL 8.6+ ships ansible-core in AppStream. The 'ansible' package is the full collection bundle.

puppet.notes: Install from Puppet Inc repository for RHEL 8.

chef.notes: Chef is not in RHEL repos. Install from Chef (Progress) downloads.

amazon-cloudwatch-agent.notes: Install from the AWS RPM repo. Same package works on RHEL.

aws-cfn-bootstrap.notes: Install from AWS. Available as pip package or RPM.

amazon-efs-utils.notes: Build from source or install from AWS repo for RHEL.

lustre-client.notes: Amazon FSx Lustre client must be built for the RHEL kernel version.

realmd.notes: Available in RHEL 8 BaseOS for Active Directory integration.

yum.notes: RHEL 8 ships yum as a symlink to dnf. Full backward compatibility.

yum-utils.notes: Available in RHEL 8 BaseOS (wraps dnf plugins).

epel-release.notes: EPEL for RHEL 8 available. Install from EPEL repo.
